title: Certify the maximum paired-cut deficit on the P104 804-bank witness
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The strongest designated #7113 paired cut on the fixed 804-bank, balanced-plane witness from #7857 has deficit exactly 50 in each direction. A 50-label independent set attains the deficit. A cover by 28 edges and four odd cycles certifies optimality. Appending banks while preserving the original fields and banks then forces at least 100 added nested banks and D+R ≥ 128. Arbitrary deletion, replacement or redesign of the banks remains open.

## Task and overlap

Uses #7852 at 41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212 and the fixed witness in #7857 at c55b7721e1a8ef438f7b932f07e4e05ab24897b9. #7869 records the general network and rise targets. This checker concerns one explicit bank set and one append-only repair policy.

## Validation and credit

The manifest and python3 -B -S verify.py pass in a standalone extraction and check attainment and optimality. The package gives the sources, proof and mutation control. DreamingOfClouds supplied the P104 model. Research, checks and packaging used OpenAI Codex.

## Open next questions

A redesigned bank set and the full hJ and hV obligations remain open.
